correctness.rationale: For every k≥2, G_k(n)=n^k is injective and completely multiplicative, hence quasi-injective. For distinct a,b, take prime r∤ab; ord_r(ar)=ord_r(br)=1, so neither ar nor br is a perfect kth power. Thus F_k(ar)=ar ≠ br=F_k(br), establishing F_k quasi-injective. As G_k(n) is always a perfect kth power, (F_k∘G_k)(n)=1 identically and fails quasi-injectivity. This is a symbolic all-k proof; packaged finite verifier is regression only.

originality.rationale: Pongsriiam 2021 expressly asks whether quasi-injective functions are closed under composition in Question 19 and gives a separate sufficient surjective-completely-multiplicative inner condition. The present infinite power-map family answers that open question negatively and shows injective-completely-multiplicative alone does not suffice. The distinct Resultary positive result for right-composition by divisor-function iterates does not imply the counterexample.
